# CombineRGBA

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Combine r, g, b, and a into a color (range 0-255).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/combine-rgba",
  "type": "CombineRGBAOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/combine-rgba').par.r` (an input) and `op('/combine-rgba').out.color` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.r`, `out.color`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `r` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `g` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `b` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `a` | `NumberField` | `255` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |

<!-- gen:end outputs -->

<!-- Add hand-written "## Remarks" and "## Examples" sections here. See the operator reference index for what goes in them. -->

## Remarks

Each channel, alpha included, runs from 0 to 255. Fractions round to the nearest whole number and values outside 0 to 255 clamp, so `127.6` becomes `128` and `300` becomes `255`. Alpha defaults to 255, which is opaque.
